introduction.title: Building reliable, human-centered digital products.
paragraphs: Hey, I’m Zaw Zaw Myint (Zack), a Software Developer based in Dubai, UAE. I’ve worked in web development for over five years, building modern frontend and full-stack web experiences.
I work across React, Next.js, TypeScript, Nuxt, and CMS platforms such as Strapi and Payload, turning complex requirements into accessible, responsive, and maintainable products.

I care about clean architecture, performance, localization, and thoughtful interaction design. I also use agentic coding tools to accelerate research, testing, and delivery while keeping engineering judgment at the center.
introduction.currentAfter: I build multilingual web experiences and CMS-powered features for the MH Markets and NEEX financial trading platforms.
introduction.closingBefore: I’m passionate about continuous learning and open to exciting collaborations. Explore my work on
introduction.closingAfter: and let’s create something meaningful together.
